title: An ambiguous request produces at most one clarifying question before routing
risk: The system keeps asking questions or bounces the customer between agents, so the customer abandons the conversation.
preconditions: Tenant T1 session sess-a-1 with the ambiguous utterance 'how much is the thing I saw?' in namespace orc-clarify-*
Clarification rule configured as at most one question before routing or human handoff

inputs.utterance: how much is the thing I saw?

steps.action: Submit the ambiguous utterance and read the decision
steps.expected: the decision is flagged requires_clarification and the plan contains exactly one send_message step

steps.action: Replay ambiguous utterances for three turns without any disambiguating information
steps.expected: the run escalates to human handoff instead of emitting a second or third clarifying question

steps.action: Submit a request that becomes unambiguous after one clarification
steps.expected: routing happens with a named agent and a reason, and no further question is asked

steps.action: Read the decision audit for the session
steps.expected: the questions asked per run are counted and never exceed one

assertions: The clarification plan contains exactly one one-step question with the send_message skill
Three consecutive ambiguous turns produce a human handoff rather than a second question
The audited question count per run never exceeds 1
forbidden: Ask a second clarifying question in the same run
Route an unresolved ambiguity to a random agent to keep the conversation moving
evidence: Decision records per turn with the clarification flag
Audit count of clarifying questions and the human-handoff record
cleanup: Delete the run-scoped decision and message rows for orc-clarify-*; keep audit entries
automation: Drive the real orchestrator with ambiguous fixture utterances and a counting test sink for outbound questions; the oracle is the audited question count plus the handoff record.
note: Generated acceptance specification. Plain specification, not an executable test; no application runtime exists, so the status is NOT_RUN.
